feature: A GIF plays at the speed of the edit
summary: A GIF from Export or from Copy as GIF now runs as long as the edit it came from. A four second cut was a 4.2 second GIF at Standard and a 3.84 second one at High; both are now 4.0.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open a screen recording and cut it to about four seconds.
Paste it into a chat or a browser beside the editor and play both together.
Export the same edit as a GIF at High, then at Small, and open each in Quick Look.

evaluate: Does the pasted GIF finish its loop at the same moment the edit's playhead reaches the end?
Does a long GIF (a minute or more) stay in step with the edit to the end?
Does motion in the GIF at Standard still look even, with no visible stutter from frames held a hundredth longer than their neighbours?
rough: No mock covers how long a GIF runs; this is a timing fix with nothing new on screen.
At fifteen a second a GIF frame is held alternately six and seven hundredths, because the format cannot store a fifteenth. The total keeps to the clock; single frames are a hundredth apart.
